item.title: ChatGPT for Teens has special safeguards. A watchdog group finds most don't work
item.description: A study from Common Sense Media says most safeguards in ChatGPT for Teens failed. The chatbot talks to teens like a friend and doesn't alert parents when users talk about self-harm and suicide.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Why mailing a ballot close to Election Day may get it rejected for a late postmark
item.description: If you're using the U.S. Postal Service to return a ballot close to Election Day, officials recommend getting it postmarked at a post office to avoid getting caught up in mail processing changes.

item.title: Christa Pike is walking with help and eating after failed execution attempt
item.description: Pike has begun walking and eating again at a hospital a week after surviving Tennessee's attempt to execute her with lethal drugs, her attorneys said Thursday.

item.title: Isaias strengthens into Category 2 hurricane on collision course with the Gulf Coast
item.description: The first hurricane of the Atlantic season was forecast to intensify rapidly and cause dangerous conditions in the Florida Panhandle, southern Alabama and southern Mississippi when it makes landfall late Friday or early Saturday.

item.title: The long-deployed USS Lincoln returns home to San Diego Bay
item.description: The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier has returned home after a record-setting uninterrupted time at sea supporting the Iran war. The extended deployment drew attention following reports of crew stress and supply shortages.
